description.en: Walker machine “Xabungle type”

description.ja: 完全新規造形のＨＧシリーズで登場。
description.en: Introducing the HG series with a completely new model.

description.ja: 最新のフォーマットで機体形状、カラーリングを再現。
description.en: Reproduce the aircraft shape and coloring in the latest format.

description.en: In addition to the dynamic movement just like in the work, Bungle Skipper / Bungle Rover etc.

description.en: It can also be transformed into various forms.

description.ja: 特徴的な武装類が付属する他、ジロン機再現用のパーツも付属。
description.en: In addition to the unique weapons included, parts for reproducing the Giron aircraft are also included.

description.ja: ●　完全新規造形により現代に降り立つ青い閃光
description.en: ● A blue flash that descends into modern times with a completely new model

description.ja: ザブングル・タイプを最新のフォーマットでＨＧキット化。
description.en: Xabungle type converted to HGKit in the latest format.

description.ja: 機体形状、カラーリングの成形色再現はもちろん
description.en: Not to mention the reproduction of the molding color of the aircraft shape and coloring.

description.ja: あらゆる面において現代の立体物としての理想を追求。
description.en: Pursuing the ideal of a modern three-dimensional object in every aspect.

description.ja: 作中さながらの人間らしいアクションポーズも表現可能。
description.en: You can also express human-like action poses just like in the work.

description.ja: 頭部の造形は4色の成形色とクリアパーツで再現。
description.en: The head shape is reproduced with four molding colors and clear parts.

description.ja: コクピット内部も細部までディティールを表現。
description.en: The inside of the cockpit is also detailed.

description.ja: ●　豊富な武装でザブングルが大暴れ！
description.en: ● Xabungle goes on a rampage with a wealth of weapons!

description.ja: ３０ｍｍライフル（ザブングルライフル）
description.en: 30mm rifle (Xabungle rifle)

description.ja: ザブングル専用のライフルは専用の持ち手で右手に装備することが可能。
description.en: Xabungle's rifle can be equipped in the right hand with a special handle.

description.ja: ４連ハンドキャノン
description.en: 4 hand cannon

description.ja: ジョイントの付け替えにて、左右どちらの腕にも装着可能。
description.en: Can be worn on either the left or right arm by changing the joint.

description.en: 3-barreled bazooka/9-barreled rocket pod

description.ja: 肩部に装備可能な武装は、軸可動によりダイナミックな射撃シーンを再現。
description.en: Weapons that can be mounted on the shoulder reproduce dynamic shooting scenes by moving the axis.

description.ja: 各種武装を取り付けることでフル装備形態も再現可能！
description.en: Fully equipped form can be reproduced by attaching various weapons!

description.ja: ●　現代の技術でザブングル・タイプの変形を実現！
description.en: ● Realizes Xabungle type transformation with modern technology!

description.ja: 変形には一部差し換えパーツを使用。
description.en: Some replacement parts are used for transformation.

description.ja: 再現度・パーツ数・工程数のバランスを追求。
description.en: Pursuing a balance between reproducibility, number of parts, and number of processes.

description.ja: 繰り返し変形したくなる仕様。
description.en: Specifications that make you want to transform repeatedly.

description.ja: 合体シークエンスも再現可能。
description.en: Combination sequences can also be reproduced.

description.ja: ●　ＨＧザブングル・タイプは“ウイング”と“腕部”の差し替えでジロン機も再現可能。
description.en: ● HG Xabungle type can also be recreated as a Jiron machine by replacing the "wings " and " arms".

description.ja: 破損状態を再現したウイングパーツも付属。
description.en: Wing parts that reproduce the damaged state are also included.

description.ja: タイヤ無し状態再現用の腕部パーツも付属。
description.en: Arm parts are also included to reproduce the condition without tires.

description.ja: 形状の異なる胸部パーツ２種が付属。選択組み立て可能。
description.en: Two types of chest parts with different shapes are included. Selective assembly possible.

description.ja: ●　最新のフォーマットだからできる！
description.en: ● It's possible because it's the latest format!

description.ja: 劇中さながらのダイナミックアクション
